from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
root=Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
m=json.loads(Path('/tmp/astra-pass94-inputs.json').read_text())
for name,digest in (m['hashes']|m['dependency_hashes']).items():
 data=(root/name).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==digest,name
 assert data.endswith(b'\n'),name
 assert all(line.rstrip()==line for line in data.splitlines()),name
for b in m['document_bindings']:
 assert b['sha256'] in (root/b['document']).read_text(),b
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/b['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==b['sha256'],b
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.audit_lean_trust import source_has_forbidden_constructs
leanfiles=[root/'LonelyRunner.lean',*sorted((root/'LonelyRunner').rglob('*.lean'))]
assert not [str(p) for p in leanfiles if source_has_forbidden_constructs(p.read_text())]
assert 'import LonelyRunner.MinimalCounterexample' in (root/'LonelyRunner.lean').read_text()
for n in m['required_theorems']:
 assert '#print axioms '+n in (root/'LonelyRunner/AxiomAudit.lean').read_text(),n
 assert '"'+n+'"' in (root/'scripts/audit_lean_trust.py').read_text(),n
commands=[]
for argv in ([sys.executable,'-B','scripts/validate_workflow.py'],['git','diff','--check']):
 r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
 commands.append(dict(argv=argv,exit_code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr));assert r.returncode==0,commands[-1]
print(json.dumps(dict(frozen_files=len(m['hashes']),dependency_bindings=len(m['dependency_hashes']),document_bindings=len(m['document_bindings']),source_scan_files=len(leanfiles),required_axiom_probes=len(m['required_theorems']),commands=commands),indent=2))
